sections.title: Care that *comes to you*
sections.intro: Your pets stay home, with their own beds, smells and routines. No kennel stress, and no favors to ask of friends.

items.title: Pet sitting
items.text: Feeding, fresh water, playtime, medications, walks and yard cleanup while you're away.

items.title: Cat sitting
items.text: Tailored to your cat's personality, whether she wants extra play, lots of affection or to be left alone.

items.title: Dog walking
items.text: Midday walks and potty breaks for dogs who are alone all day or have energy to burn.

items.title: Overnight sits
items.text: A sleeping buddy for your pets and an occupied house while you travel.

items.title: House sitting
items.text: Peace of mind for an empty house while you and your pets travel as snowbirds or on long trips.

items.title: The lived-in look
items.text: Lights turned on and off and plants watered while you're away.

sections.title: Services *and rates*
sections.intro: Rates are based on the care time your pets need, not on how many pets you have.
sections.footnote: Rates effective January 1, 2023, as posted on the current website. Holiday or short-notice fees of about $5 may apply. Need something not listed? Just ask.

items.title: Call or email
items.text: Tell us about your pets and the dates you'll be away.

items.title: In-home consultation
items.text: We meet you and your pets and learn their habits, routines and anything else we need to know.

items.title: Book online
items.text: Once you're set up, schedule visits through the client login and get quick confirmation.

items.title: Relax
items.text: We send updates and photos while you're gone.

sections.title: June Crawford, *a lifelong pet person*
body: June has cared for her own and other people's pets since she was a little girl in Harrison, Arkansas. After a career in statistics, programming and systems analysis that began in 1982, she founded Aiken Pet Sitters in 2005, and she still says she loves her job.

She keeps her Certified Professional Pet Sitter credential current through Pet Sitters International. At home there are currently eight cats, and June gives time and donations to Stray Cat Outreach, PAWS, FOTAS, the Albrecht Center SPCA and other animal groups.

images.alt: A shaggy black-and-white dog on a red leash

items.text: June and friends have been looking after Dude for about seven years now. Long vacations are tough on cats, but June takes away the loneliness with brushing, playing and loving. Dude starts purring when June drops by, even when we're home.

June Crawford and her wonderful sitters have showered our house full of pets with love and the best possible pet sitting care for over a decade. We have had as many as seven pets at one time, dogs and cats.

sections.title: Going out of town?
sections.text: Book your in-home consultation early, especially around the holidays.
